text.p: Aluminium of Greece has started to implement an intensive programme, part of the Pechiney Group's worldwide "Challenge" plan, to improve its competitiveness in the medium-to-long term.

Aluminium of Greece said it would reap the benefits of the plan from 1999 with an increased "industrial margin" of $43 million, assuming market conditions remain similar to those prevailing at the end of 1995.
The programme will be enhanced by investments of $70 million or 16.8 billion drachmas from now until 2001, it said in a statement.
The increase of productivity entails restructuring its operations and reducing its workforce by offering early retirement schemes to some of its employees.
Aluminium of Greece is a subsidiary of the Pechiney Group.
